description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 2079/50 of 12.07.2018 - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying land parcel details, ownership types, access rights, and servitude arrangements for multiple properties in various locations. It contains no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories - focusing solely on land registration and property matters.
